Experts from Harvard Business School giv: The purpose of this article is twofold: to spur managers to think more expansively about how trends could engender new value propositions in their core markets, and to provide some high-level advice on how to make market research and product development personnel more adept at analyzing and exploiting trends.
哈佛商学院的专家为管理者提出建议。: 本文有两个目的：一是促使管理者拓宽思路，思考趋势如何在核心市场中催生新的价值主张；二是给出一些总体建议，帮助市场研究和产品开发人员更善于分析并利用趋势。

Experts from Harvard Business School giv: One strategy, known as ‘infuse and augment’, is to design a product or service that retains most of the attributes and functions of existing products in the category but adds others that address the needs and desires unleashed by a major trend.
哈佛商学院的专家为管理者提出建议。: 一种策略可称为“融入并增益”：设计产品或服务时，保留同品类现有产品的大部分属性和功能，再加入其他特点，回应某一大趋势激发的新需求和欲望。
column8: address the needs and desires|回应需求与欲望

Experts from Harvard Business School giv: A case in point is the Poppy range of handbags, which the firm Coach created in response to the economic downturn of 2008.
哈佛商学院的专家为管理者提出建议。: 蔻驰公司为应对2008年的经济低迷而推出的Poppy系列手袋，就是一例。
Experts|n. 专家: A case in point|一个恰当的例子

Experts from Harvard Business School giv: The Coach brand had been a symbol of opulence and luxury for nearly 70 years, and the most obvious reaction to the downturn would have been to lower prices.
哈佛商学院的专家为管理者提出建议。: 蔻驰品牌近70年来一直象征着富裕与奢华。面对经济低迷，最容易想到的应对方式本来是降价。

Experts from Harvard Business School giv: However, that would have risked cheapening the brand’s image.
哈佛商学院的专家为管理者提出建议。: 不过，那样做有损害品牌高端形象的风险。
Experts|n. 专家: would have risked|本会带来……的风险

哈佛商学院的专家为管理者提出建议。: 蔻驰转而启动了一项消费者研究，发现顾客迫切希望自己和国家都能走出困境。

Experts from Harvard Business School giv: Using these insights, Coach launched the lower-priced Poppy handbags, which were in vibrant colors, and looked more youthful and playful than conventional Coach products.
哈佛商学院的专家为管理者提出建议。: 根据这些发现，蔻驰推出了价位较低的Poppy手袋。这个系列色彩鲜明，比传统蔻驰产品更显年轻活泼。

Experts from Harvard Business School giv: Creating the sub-brand allowed Coach to avert an across-the-board price cut.
哈佛商学院的专家为管理者提出建议。: 建立这一子品牌，使蔻驰避开了全线降价。

Experts from Harvard Business School giv: In contrast to the many companies that responded to the recession by cutting prices, Coach saw the new consumer mindset as an opportunity for innovation and renewal.
哈佛商学院的专家为管理者提出建议。: 许多企业靠降价应对经济衰退，蔻驰则把消费者新出现的心态视为创新和更新品牌的机会。

Experts from Harvard Business School giv: A further example of this strategy was supermarket Tesco’s response to consumers’ growing concerns about the environment.
哈佛商学院的专家为管理者提出建议。: 另一个采用这项策略的例子，是乐购超市对消费者日益关心环境所作的回应。

Experts from Harvard Business School giv: With that in mind, Tesco, one of the world’s top five retailers, introduced its Greener Living program, which demonstrates the company’s commitment to protecting the environment by involving consumers in ways that produce tangible results.
哈佛商学院的专家为管理者提出建议。: 考虑到这一点，全球五大零售商之一乐购推出了“更环保的生活”计划。通过让消费者参与能产生切实成果的行动，这项计划展示了乐购保护环境的承诺。
Experts|n. 专家: With that in mind|考虑到这一点
managers|n. 管理者: Greener Living|“更环保的生活”计划

Experts from Harvard Business School giv: For example, Tesco customers can accumulate points for such activities as reusing bags, recycling cans and printer cartridges, and buying home-insulation materials.

Experts from Harvard Business School giv: Tesco has not abandoned its traditional retail offerings but augmented its business with these innovations, thereby infusing its value proposition with a green streak.
哈佛商学院的专家为管理者提出建议。: 乐购保留了原有的零售业务，同时利用这些创新拓展业务，让自己的价值主张添上了环保色彩。

Experts from Harvard Business School giv: A more radical strategy is ‘combine and transcend’.

Experts from Harvard Business School giv: This entails combining aspects of the product’s existing value proposition with attributes addressing changes arising from a trend, to create a novel experience – one that may land the company in an entirely new market space.
哈佛商学院的专家为管理者提出建议。: 这一做法把产品既有价值主张的某些方面，同那些能回应趋势所带来变化的特性结合起来，创造出全新的体验，甚至可能让企业进入一个完全不同的市场。

哈佛商学院的专家为管理者提出建议。: Nike+运动套件和配套网页把耐克原本面向业余运动者的价值主张，与面向数字产品消费者的价值主张结合起来，使公司不再只专注于运动服饰，还进入了与顾客互动的新层面。

哈佛商学院的专家为管理者提出建议。: 第三项策略叫作“抵消并重申”：开发产品或服务时突出该品类一贯代表的价值，使消费者能抵制趋势中自己不喜欢的部分，或至少获得暂时摆脱它们的机会。

Experts from Harvard Business School giv: Like other handheld games, the device featured a host of exciting interactive games, a full-color LCD screen, and advanced 3D graphics.
哈佛商学院的专家为管理者提出建议。: 这台设备和其他掌上游戏机一样，配有许多有趣的互动游戏、全彩液晶屏，以及先进的三维图形功能。

哈佛商学院的专家为管理者提出建议。: ME2在2008年年中推出，既迎合了孩子对电子游戏的强烈兴趣，也抵消了人们关于这类游戏会导致缺乏运动和肥胖等负面联想。

Experts from Harvard Business School giv: Once you have gained perspective on how trend-related changes in consumer opinions and behaviors impact on your category, you can determine which of our three innovation strategies to pursue.
哈佛商学院的专家为管理者提出建议。: 了解趋势引起的消费者看法和行为变化会怎样影响自己的产品品类之后，企业便可决定采用哪一种创新策略。
Experts|n. 专家: gained perspective on|看清，对……形成认识
Harvard Business School|哈佛商学院: trend-related changes|与趋势相关的变化

Experts from Harvard Business School giv: When your category’s basic value proposition continues to be meaningful for consumers influenced by the trend, the infuse-and-augment strategy will allow you to reinvigorate the category.
哈佛商学院的专家为管理者提出建议。: 当某个品类原有的价值主张对受到趋势影响的消费者仍有意义时，采用“融入并增益”策略可以使这个品类重新焕发活力。
Experts|n. 专家: basic value proposition|基本价值主张

Experts from Harvard Business School giv: If analysis reveals an increasing disparity between your category and consumers’ new focus, your innovations need to transcend the category to integrate the two worlds.
哈佛商学院的专家为管理者提出建议。: 如果分析发现，该品类和消费者新的关注点之间差距越来越大，就需要通过创新超越品类边界，把两者结合起来。

Experts from Harvard Business School giv: Finally, if aspects of the category clash with undesired outcomes of a trend, such as associations with unhealthy lifestyles, there is an opportunity to counteract those changes by reaffirming the core values of your category.
哈佛商学院的专家为管理者提出建议。: 最后，如果某品类的特点与趋势带来的不良后果发生冲突，例如它容易让人联想到不健康的生活方式，企业就有机会通过重申该品类的核心价值来抵消这些影响。
